descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S25 「Ask AI 失败或什么都没返回，两种模式：明确的提示，没有回答，打的问题还在」 Ask AI fails or returns nothing, both contexts: explicit message, no answer, the typed question kept

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 Ask AI failed: an explicit error and no invented answer; what the physician typed is kept; the app retries, then the backup model answers or a clear message shows — never waiting with nothing.（UAT Empty & Failure States；UAT 3.5）
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 3；UAT 3.4）
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3).（UAT 3.3；TFA-92593 AC 9）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Make-session fixture; every ai/assist:askChart call fails (cp1–cp2), then every call returns an empty string (cp3–cp4)

When Type "What is the latest potassium?" (not a preset label) and tap Ask AI on Hospital Pre-Round, NH Encounter, Hospital Encounter and NH Pre-Round

Then Failed call: the 'couldn’t be reached … tap Ask AI again' copy; empty reply: the 'returned no answer' copy; no 'Patient Record' answer block, no lab value, not stuck on 'Searching…', the typed question still in the box

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U9: each checkpoint mustContain 'latest potassium' (question kept) and its failure copy; mustNotContain 'Patient Record', 'Searching', 'WBC', 'mmol', 'mEq'. Same case as EFS S10 / OAT-03 S06: run once, report under all three

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
